findings: In UTC, the explicit +01:00 vector returns 2026-11-06T10:30:00Z; its correct instant is 09:30:00Z, a 3600000 ms error.
With JVM default GMT+02:00, both Z and .000Z vectors return 08:30:00Z instead of 10:30:00Z, errors of -7200000 ms; +01:00 returns 08:30:00Z instead of 09:30:00Z, an error of -3600000 ms.
The two UTC-default Z/.000Z matching rows do not disprove the offset defect: default UTC masks the missing explicit-zone handling for these values.

Source inference, not an instrumented pattern trace: the first format quotes Z as literal text without setting UTC; later timezone-free patterns accept a prefix. No fractional-second format is supplied. Java DateFormat.parse(String) permits unconsumed suffix text, consistent with the observed .000Z and colon-offset outputs.

The helper directly invokes the public Original RSSUtils method from the exact existing CoreJar. Classpath classes contain only the probe and its SecurityManager subclass; no RSSUtils replacement, reflection, Core creation/start or UI invocation is present.

primary_references.support: UTC is local time minus the numeric offset, so 10:30+01:00 denotes 09:30Z.
Z/numeric offsets and optional fractional seconds are valid timestamp syntax; Z denotes UTC as explained in sections 4.2/4.3.
parse(String) may succeed after consuming only an input prefix.
Quoted pattern characters are literal; z/Z/X are zone pattern letters.

network_control.successful_control: Actual host log contains SOCKET_GUARD_CONTROL_PASS before all 6 date rows. The JDK17 SecurityManager rejects Java connect/listen/accept calls; the helper tests a loopback Socket and expects SecurityException.
network_control.scope: Java API-level guard; no claim of OS seccomp/socket-deny-exec isolation or a successful network connection.
network_control.earlier_failure: Sandbox Socket creation throws SocketException(Operation not permitted), wrapped in AssertionError, before guardPASS/date output. This is not a date result and remains a separate failed control attempt.
network_control.reuse: Root reports reusing unchanged compiled classes for the host attempt. Current class/source images are pinned here; no additional compilation or JVM execution was performed by the reviewer.

scope_limits: Measured public method behavior on Original cb8 through existing CoreJar and JDK17.0.20 only; no full feed, subscription engine, GUI display, live profile or Core.start reproduction.
RSSItemImpl/RSSChannelImpl source call this method for Atom publication dates, but those caller/UI paths were not executed by this probe.
